access_limitations: Bash network remains GitHub and arXiv only. A curl to www.eecg.utoronto.ca was denied by the sandbox proxy (deny network-outbound, host not on the allow list), so no paper bytes were saved and no paper file hash exists.
Direct WebFetch returned the SRC-066 PDF as compressed binary without extractable text. The tool saved a binary copy in a directory the file tools are denied, so it was not read.

All paper content passed through two intermediaries: the r.jina.ai extraction service and WebFetch's summarizing model. Locators and short quotes are as returned and need verifier re-checking against the originals.
The TCAD 2010 full text is not open access (OpenAlex is_oa false). The NTU thesis full text is fee-licensed. Neither was obtained, and no authentication was bypassed.
